summary: Iteration 6: logo relocation and backend simplification. The hero has no [data-testid=hero-logos]; the logo row under 'What can I help you with?' is gone. Every logo mapping matches the spec. Intro: KMG->kmg, On air->grk, Koodh->koodh. Skills: Websites & AI->koodh+radiogroep, Radio->topradio+grk, Microsoft 365->none. Work cards: OVB->ovb, Koodh/KMG->koodh+kmg, 127->none, Nostalgie->radiogroep. More-work cards on the detail pages (checked on 2 pages) use the same mapping. CV timeline: Koodh, KMG, Radio GRK, TOPradio and Radiogroep (radiogroep+thomasmore) have logos; Autosoft, Studio Sonart, Telenet and MFY have none. All logo images load (none broken). Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390) and timeline h4 headings are one line with no overflow. Backend: /api/health returns {status:ok}, /api/status returns 404 (removed, as intended), and /api/experiences, every /api/experiences/{id}, /api/img and /api/sitemap.xml return 200. Pytest: 28/28 passed (new test_iter6_health.py plus test_experiences.py and test_img_proxy.py). No console errors and no 4xx/5xx responses.

ui_bugs.issue: The skills cards container has class 'cards3 c3 rv', and 'c3' is also the card class. So card-scoped rules such as '.c3:hover .blogo{margin-left:4px}' also match the wrapper: hovering anywhere in the skills grid spreads the logo stacks in all 3 cards at once instead of only the hovered card. It also matches a querySelectorAll('.c3') as a pseudo-card.

issues: The OVB Congres and Radiogroep logos are wordmarks; at 44px (28px in the CV) the text is unreadable. Consider an icon or monogram variant or a larger badge.
The TOPradio logo looks slightly cropped inside the round badge

action_items: Optional: rename the 'c3' class on the skills wrapper (.cards3.c3) so card hover rules apply per card
Optional: improve legibility of the wordmark logos (OVB, Radiogroep) in the small badges
critical_code_review_comments: logosFor uses ordered regex RULES on the article title. This is fragile if CMS titles change (e.g. a title containing both 'koodh' and 'radio' takes the first match). Acceptable for now; could use CMS tags instead.
server.py: CORS allow_credentials=True with a '*' origin default; fine for a public read-only API, but set CORS_ORIGINS in production
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo testids are logo-{id}. Work card ids: OVB 4e152384, Koodh dcb6fd81, 127 d965477d, Nostalgie 3f4564a9. I did not run the destructive iter4/iter5 suites this round, to keep the img cache warm. Production ynnck.dev was not tested.
